Legal

Privacy Policy

Last updated: May 11, 2026. We are committed to protecting your personal information and your right to privacy.

{/* Content Section */}

1. Information Collection

As a freelance developer, I collect personal and business information that you voluntarily provide when inquiring about services, requesting project proposals, or entering into contracts.

This includes names, email addresses, phone numbers, billing addresses, project specifications, and any sensitive business data shared during our collaboration.

2. Use of Your Information

The information collected is used exclusively for professional purposes related to providing freelance web development and software engineering services.

  • To deliver requested digital products and services.
  • To communicate project updates and milestone progress.
  • To issue invoices and process payments.
  • To showcase completed work in my portfolio (strictly with prior client consent).
  • To comply with legal, tax, and accounting obligations.

3. Data Sharing & Confidentiality

Client confidentiality is paramount. I do not sell, rent, or trade your personal or business information to third parties. Information is only shared with trusted third-party tools (such as payment processors or hosting providers) strictly necessary to execute the project, or when required by law. All intellectual property and source code remain secure under our agreed Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs).

4. Data Retention

I retain client information and project assets for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this policy, typically the duration of the project warranty period plus the legally mandated tax record period. Upon request, I will permanently delete your sensitive assets from my local development environment.

5. Contact Information

If you have questions about how your data is handled or wish to request the deletion of your project files, please email me directly at contact@example.com.
